HoiThoaiList.NoiDung: So? How do you feel when being injured by your own techniques?

HoiThoaiList.NoiDung: The Royal Court, using the Starry Sky Sect, has instigated the war between Holy-yang Sect and the Good-Evil Sects, plotting to destroy both side.
But how do you know it?

NhiemVuList.MoTa: Arrow of Wan Qing, why must she use this to communicate?
Wear your night robe, this needs to be secret

Just let them follow us to find out their motive!

Confront the troops of the White Tiger Cult of the Starry Sky Sect.

Find us if you dare, 3 days late at Mingjing lake.

Blood stain the Black Turtle river.

A mysterious man, seems to be very important.
Taken a hit from the newcomer, his skill is not to be underestimated.
The Heaven Elder, he is stronger than before.
Another Elder of the Starry Sky Sect has appeared.

Clean up those pawns

Ambush again!

MoTa: Wan Qing 's death! By my blade. The Starry Sky Sect retreated. But the army from the Royal Court is prepared to attack here.
